metadata.title: Apple Set to Lose Stock-Market Crown After Earnings

content.text:
LIVE
1 hour ago
Apple Set to Lose Stock-Market Crown After Earnings
Apple reported solid earnings last night, but signs that its growth engine is slowing sent the stock sliding about 4% in premarket trading.
If the stock sustains its losses, it's set to lose its place as the largest company by market cap.
Nvidia, whose shares are up over 2% premarket, is on course to dethrone the iPhone maker. The two companies have traded places on the top spot three times so far this year, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
